overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Automatic mode -- shown only when necessary; not available for text-object fields/variables or subforms
Automatic mode -- shown only when necessary; not available for text-object fields/variables or subforms

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Shows, hides, or (for object types that support it) sets automatic-mode visibility of the horizontal and/or vertical scrollbars of the object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: Automatic mode (2) is not available for text-object fields/variables or subforms.
